core_obligations: Show that equation-cycle-classes is surjective for f : X -> S finite type with S the spectrum of a DVR (proof lines 1240-1247). This follows from lemma-get-cycles (tag 0H59) (proof lines 1241-1242); directly: let alpha be a relative r-cycle on X/S, write the generic fibre alpha_eta = sum n_i [Z_i] (finite sum), denote Zbar_i the closure of Z_i in X as in section-specialization (tag 0H4H); both alpha and sum n_i [Zbar_i/X/S] are relative cycles with the same generic fibre, hence agree by uniqueness of relative cycles with given generic fibre (one-step identification; soft-point note), so alpha = sum n_i [Zbar_i/X/S] and alpha lies in the image (proof lines 1242-1246).
proof_roadmap: Cite the general get-cycles lemma for the surjectivity (proof lines 1241-1242).
Direct argument: finite expression of the generic fibre and closure construction from the specialization section (proof lines 1242-1246).
Identify alpha with the reconstructed sum via uniqueness of relative cycles with given generic fibre (proof lines 1245-1246).
